questions.prompt: Heads-up on the river, a tight opponent checks to you and you have a medium pair. You might…

choices.text: Bet thin for value. One player can call worse.
Always check because medium pairs are air heads-up

questions.explanation: Heads-up value is thinner than multiway value.

questions.prompt: Five players on the flop, you have top pair weak kicker. Best default?

choices.text: Bet small or check. Do not bluff and do not stack off.

questions.explanation: Weak kickers hate multiway pots. Someone has a better kicker or two pair more often.

questions.prompt: You are between two players who have not acted. A bluff is…

choices.text: Worse than when you are last to act.

questions.explanation: Players behind can raise. Bluff when you close the action, not into a live button.

questions.prompt: A short stack is all-in and a deep stack is behind. With a strong but not nut hand you…

choices.text: Can call the short stack and still fold to a huge side-pot bet.
Must call every side-pot bet because you called the short stack

questions.explanation: The two pots are different prices. Do not chain them into one decision.
